top_stories.title: How attackers turned a Teams meeting booking into a device code phishing trap
top_stories.summary: Attackers conducted a device code phishing attack by impersonating a Microsoft Teams meeting scheduler to trick an employee into entering a device code on Microsoft's legitimate login page, bypassing MFA and obtaining a valid session token. The attack exploits Microsoft's device code authentication flow, where the attacker initiates a sign-in, generates a code, and social engineers the victim into authenticating on their behalf.

top_stories.title: Suspected North Korean IT workers reached onboarding at companies with open data
top_stories.summary: Material Security tracked 27 suspected North Korean fake IT worker personas that successfully reached the onboarding stage at monitored companies over one year, out of 2,429 total personas identified. The research highlights identity verification failures in hiring pipelines, with one affected company exposing approximately 277,000 files containing Social Security numbers company-wide.

top_stories.title: Citrix Patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client Flaws, Including Authentication Bypass
top_stories.summary: Citrix has released patches for multiple critical security flaws in NetScaler ADC, NetScaler Gateway, and NetScaler Console, including an authentication bypass vulnerability. The authentication bypass flaw (CVE-2026-120868) carries a CVSS score of 9.3 and affects widely deployed Citrix network access and gateway products.

top_stories.title: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
top_stories.summary: A phishing campaign active since mid-August 2026 has been stealing live Google sessions from corporate users through proxy-based session hijacking that bypasses standard link-checking defenses. Material Security's Threat Research team identified the operation, dubbed Operation CloudFire, and has taken down hundreds of attacker domains used in the campaign.

top_stories.title: We Built An Agent That Broke All of Our Security Rules. Here's What We Learned.
top_stories.summary: Token describes building an AI agent that violated all three of its own security principles—distinct identity, least-privilege access, and separate traceability—by default. The article explores how AI agents operating within authenticated user sessions create identity and access management challenges around non-human identities, access scoping, and audit trails.

news.title: When an AI Agent Goes Wrong, Can You Stop It?
news.summary: The article examines identity and authorization challenges posed by AI agents, specifically how an agent's granted identity and tool permissions can be exploited to perform unintended or malicious actions. The scenario presented highlights gaps in access control and authorization enforcement when AI agents operate with broad permissions, a direct concern for IAM practitioners.

news.title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
news.summary: A threat actor dubbed SilentAir has been discovered hijacking Asian telecom networks to intercept SMS-based two-factor authentication codes and spy on Taiwanese users. Enea, a Stockholm-based telecom and cybersecurity firm, identified attack sources in at least six Asian countries and assessed with high confidence that SilentAir is a state-level actor.

news.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
news.summary: An international law enforcement operation (Operation Endgame) took down servers running Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC malware used to steal credentials and enable ransomware attacks. Police seized approximately 6.4 million stolen login credentials belonging to over 40,000 victims, as reported by Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office (BKA).

news.title: Extortion Group Luna Moth Flits Into Law Firms a Second Time
news.summary: The Luna Moth extortion group is targeting law firms using social engineering attacks designed to steal Microsoft access tokens. The campaign specifically re-targets organizations that previously refused to pay ransoms, with credential and token theft as the primary attack vector.

news.title: Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted that addresses identity blind spots in Security Operations Center (SOC) environments. The session focuses on identifying who or what is behind suspicious activity—including human users, machine accounts, and AI agents—and what access they have during security investigations.

news.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
news.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit called SignDrop has been released that claims to allow local Windows users to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level via the Common Log File System (CLFS) driver. The exploit abuses a log-authentication feature in clfs.sys by using path redirection when a privileged process opens a prepared log file.

news.title: Attacker Used 4,837 Hijacked GitHub Accounts to Run a CI Secret Stealer in 1,806+ Repositories
news.summary: An attacker used stolen credentials from 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts to plant a secret-stealing tool across more than 1,806 repositories, according to Aikido Security. The malware targeted secrets and cloud credentials accessible through CI/CD workflows, representing a supply chain credential theft campaign.

news.title: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools
news.summary: Amazon Web Services published guidance on implementing fine-grained, per-user access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools exposed to AI agents via AgentCore Gateway. The solution uses a request interceptor to inject verified identity and policies in AgentCore to enforce authorization independently for each user.

news.title: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
news.summary: Action1 published content warning that endpoint management platforms pose significant security risks if compromised, enabling malware deployment and mass device disruption. The piece promotes customer-controlled cryptographic authorization as a mitigation approach.

news.title: Microsoft Entra adds a seven-day safeguard against irreversible identity deletion
news.summary: Microsoft Entra has introduced Hard Deletion Protection, currently in preview, which provides a seven-day recovery window before selected identities are permanently deleted. The feature targets both accidental and malicious identity deletion scenarios, giving administrators a safeguard against irreversible data loss.

news.title: Critical Zoom Workplace Flaw Could Allow Unauthenticated Remote Privilege Escalation
news.summary: Zoom has patched two security vulnerabilities in Zoom Workplace for Windows, including a critical flaw (CVE-2026-108186, CVSS 9.6) involving improper input validation. The vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated user to conduct privilege escalation on affected systems.

news.title: Over 35,000 Grok-Built Apps Exposed Online, Some Leaking Confidential Data and Passwords
news.summary: Security researchers at Claroc found that 35,578 out of 37,571 Grok-built apps were publicly accessible without authentication. Approximately 10% of these exposed apps contained internal business data, confidential information, and passwords.

news.title: How Samsung Ads federated Snowflake Iceberg tables using Amazon Cognito
news.summary: Samsung Ads implemented a federated data architecture using Amazon Cognito for OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication to connect Snowflake Iceberg tables with AWS Lake Formation and Amazon Athena. The solution uses Cognito specifically as an OAuth2 token provider for service-to-service authentication in a data pipeline context.

news.title: SUIT - Security & Unified Identity Toolkit
news.summary: SUIT (Security & Unified Identity Toolkit) is a new enterprise security and identity governance module released for Drupal 11. It implements Zero Standing Privileges, Just-In-Time Privileged Identity Management, session protection, and step-up re-authentication capabilities.

news.title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
news.summary: A flaw in Claude Code, an AI coding agent, causes files containing credentials and other sensitive secrets to be inadvertently committed and exposed in public GitHub repositories. The issue creates credential leakage risks for organizations using AI-assisted development tools, with thousands of secrets potentially exposed.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside security updates from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.
